reply.content:
Yes. CVS Health disclosed several significant legal matters that remained ongoing as of 2022:

- **Opioid litigation:** The company faced numerous federal and state cases. After a 2021 jury verdict, a court entered a **$651 million judgment in 2022**; CVS was appealing and had not accrued a liability. CVS also described a 2022 multistate settlement agreement with maximum payments of approximately **$4.3 billion for remediation plus $625 million in fees, costs and additional remediation**, payable over 10 years (p. 174).
- **PBM lawsuits and investigations:** CVS faced lawsuits over drug pricing and manufacturer rebates, along with investigations and information requests from the FTC and state attorneys general (p. 173).
- **Prescription and controlled-substance matters:** The company reported a DOJ subpoena received in 2020 and a related CID in 2022 concerning opioid and controlled-substance practices, as well as ongoing prescription-processing claims and investigations (p. 175).

The filing says CVS was defending itself against these claims and investigations (pp. 173–175).
